corrections.explanation: Lampert's own official site (lampertcigars.com/cigars/ocean-breeze/) does not use the name 'Robusto Extra' at all - it calls this exact 5x54 vitola 'Robusto Grande'. Dimensions match exactly and halfwheel/retailer coverage confirms 'Robusto Grande' as the original Ocean Breeze size introduced in 2022. Likely just a naming discrepancy in the site's existing catalog entry - recommend renaming rather than treating as two different vitolas.

research_notes: Gordito (4x58) and Toro Grande (6.5x56) are genuinely distinct, officially-confirmed additional vitolas within the same Ocean Breeze blend - confirmed via Lampert's own 'expands Ocean Breeze with two new vitolas' announcement and halfwheel. Toro Grande was not in our Mac photo library at the time of this research but is flagged here for completeness/future reference. Tasting notes are the blend-level profile from the official page; no Gordito-specific breakdown was found.
